headline: April finally came into focus: Real Dough scaled reach hard, but efficiency softened, social growth is getting shallower, and the freezer aisle is getting more crowded from both premium specialists and value private label.

items: Reporting is finally fresh. This is the first weekly summary built from a true April 1 to April 30 export instead of stale March data.
Meta scale still worked: reach hit 556,775 on $4,931 spend, and 'Straight From Wisconsin' remained the clear paid winner at $0.13 CPC and 3.65% CTR.
Instagram grew fast, up 44% from 418 to 602 followers, with reach up to 424,540. The core audience is still women 35-44.
The creative story is still consistent across channels: Wisconsin origin, real-ingredient credibility, and practical dinner framing outperform generic premium messaging.
Paid efficiency is tightening as spend scales. Meta CPC rose 38% month over month ($0.13 to $0.18) while CTR fell 25% (3.47% to 2.59%).
Audience growth is getting shallower. Instagram followers surged, but engagement rate dropped from 2.38% to 1.93%, which means reach is growing faster than response.
YouTube cooled off and TikTok is effectively stalled. YouTube subscriber gains fell from 10 to 4, and TikTok generated only 1,806 views and 19 likes for the month.

Competitive pressure sharpened this week from both ends: premium brands are winning with tighter occasion stories, while private label and large CPG players are expanding value coverage and consolidating operations.
PAID: Protect budget by concentrating Meta spend around the 45-64 demo, where CPC and CTR are strongest, and cut weaker younger-audience spend.
CREATIVE: Build the next batch around Wisconsin credibility plus clear use-case framing, weeknight dinner, texture/ASMR, and family utility, instead of broad 'better frozen pizza' claims.
SEARCH: Reduce or pause competitor keyword waste, especially 'paul newman pizza' at $175.80 spend and $1.54 CPC, unless it can prove conversion value.
CONTENT: Ship a fresh YouTube texture/ASMR piece and more interactive Instagram formats to turn follower growth into actual engagement.
DATA: Fix the reviews feed and add a current Real Dough operations source. Right now Andrew still has no usable sentiment feed and no current-week ops readout.

agency_brief.what_worked: Wisconsin-origin messaging, real-ingredient proof, and practical dinner framing. 'Straight From Wisconsin' is still the most efficient paid asset, and social posts tied to pairings, testimonials, and meal utility outperform broader premium language.
agency_brief.what_didnt: Scaled generic premium creative, TikTok organic, and competitor search. Audience growth without engagement is also becoming a soft failure mode on Instagram.
agency_brief.recommendation: For the next cycle, stay narrow and specific. Keep the Wisconsin story, but package it around a faster-to-grasp occasion: weeknight dinner, texture proof, or family utility. Reallocate budget away from inefficient competitor search and weaker audience pockets, then support that with a fresh ASMR-style YouTube asset and more interactive Instagram creative.
agency_brief.competitive_context: This week's market intel was consistent: frozen is being squeezed from both sides. Premium winners are getting more occasion-specific, with sharper convenience, protein, and flavor hooks, while private label and major CPG players are widening value coverage and tightening operations. Real Dough should avoid broad premium positioning and lean harder into differentiation that private label cannot copy quickly.
